text: Not-ready/finalized globals shall select their lifecycle fault before initialized-bit checks. External regions and foreign output contracts shall explicitly establish entry/output initialization; a signature or unknown call alone shall not prove initialization. Unsupported boundaries shall require an adapter or rejection.
